learned: Buying every watched coin at the 25-min mark would have lost about 17% per trade after fees (204 coins, 13% winners). Being picky is right.
Coins with only $25k–40k liquidity at 25 min mostly rugged: 20 coins, average -44% after fees. The $40k floor stays.
Coins that had already pumped by 25 min did worse (-33% avg, n=67) than ones that had cooled off (-8%, n=119). Don't chase.

X buzz before our decision is mostly shill templates and bots. They appear on winners and rugs alike, so mention counts don't help. 23 repeat shill or bot accounts are on a deny list. No account has earned trust yet.
Coins passing the main filters (liq ≥ $40k, top 10 ≤ 25%) still lost money on average after fees (13 coins, -16.2% avg, 23% winners). No rule was loosened.
Buying sooner doesn't help. At 1 min after migration: -14% avg. At 26 min: -19%. At 60 min: -11% (still negative).
Risk exits: tighter or looser stops, trails and timeouts all changed the result by about 2 points or less. Exits are unchanged.
Buying coins that bounced back after a dip lost 22% avg (n=25). Coins whose volume was rising lost 27% (n=56). Nothing we tested had positive expected value after fees, so sitting out was correct.
